# Storage and wire cost (analytical; generated by cost_v12.py)

Bits per unit. C = number of chiplets; 16 routers and 4 VLs per chiplet; flit 32 bits; 2 VCs x 4 flits per port. Learned values as 16-bit fixed point. The last two rows give the baseline router for scale.

| method | item | per | 2x2 | 3x3 | 4x4 | note |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| DeFT(rho*), DeFT-Dis, DeFT-Ran, DeFT_OE_G, XY-SP | routing header | packet | 4 | 4 | 4 | exit and entry VL slot |
| MTR | routing header | packet | 4 | 4 | 4 | exit and entry boundary router (slot) |
| RC | routing header | packet | 4 | 4 | 4 | exit and entry boundary router (slot) |
| CI_* | routing header | packet | 6 | 6 | 6 | exit slot + entry candidate mask (4 bits) |
| FULL_* | routing header | packet | 8 | 8 | 8 | exit and entry candidate masks |
| DeFT(rho*), DeFT_OE_G | VL LUT | chiplet router | 12 | 32 | 60 | (C-1) destination chiplets x (exit + entry slot); one fault scenario held |
| CI_* | exit LUT | chiplet router | 6 | 16 | 30 | (C-1) x exit slot; entry chosen late |
| FULL_* | VL LUT | chiplet router | 0 | 0 | 0 | none (both VLs chosen late) |
| DeFT-Dis, RC | VL choice | chiplet router | 0 | 0 | 0 | nearest functional VL: comparator logic, no table |
| DeFT-Ran | VL choice | chiplet router | 0 | 0 | 0 | random generator, no table |
| MTR | NI table (destination -> entry boundary router) | chiplet router | 128 | 288 | 512 | MTR paper: per NI, destination id -> boundary router id (16C entries) |
| MTR | exit boundary router | chiplet router | 2 | 2 | 2 | outbound table entry of the source |
| MTR | turn restriction bits | boundary router | 8 | 8 | 8 | 4 inbound + 4 outbound turn enables |
| RC | RC buffer | boundary router | 1024 | 1024 | 1024 | 4 packet slots x 8 flits x 32 bits |
| RC | OPIC request/response wires | chiplet | 48 | 48 | 48 | one tree per boundary router; 12 tree edges x (2-bit request + 2-bit response) |
| RC | OPIC permission counters | chiplet router | 6 | 6 | 6 | request and permit counters (3 bits each, up to 4 slots) |
| CI_qlLA*, FULL_qlLA* | Q table (key: destination chiplet) | router with an adaptive choice | 320 | 720 | 1280 | C keys x 5 outputs x 16 bits (CI: interposer routers only; FULL: all routers) |
| *_LA (lookahead) and *_qlLA | lookahead occupancy wires | link direction | 20 | 20 | 20 | the neighbour's downstream occupancy per output (5 x 4 bits) |
| *_qlLA | learning feedback wires | link direction | 16 | 16 | 16 | value estimate returned on head arrival |
| all | credit / VC status (reference) | link direction | 6 | 6 | 6 | 2 VCs x 3-bit credit count (baseline router) |
| all | input buffers (reference) | router | 1536 | 1536 | 1536 | 6 ports x 2 VCs x 4 flits x 32 bits |
